items.text: Performance marketer with real-estate lead-generation experience on Meta and Google Ads, backed by a degree in Interactive and Game Design. I build ad messaging frameworks and lead forms, qualify buyers, and move inquiries through to booked viewings. On the creative side, I produce listing copy, short-form video scripts, Virtual Tours and 3D assets, using AI tools to speed up production while keeping the brand consistent.

bullets.text: Completed mandatory national military service, fully discharged.
Planned and ran Meta lead-gen campaigns, writing ad copy around Thai buyers’ concerns with clear calls to action, driving qualified leads for renovated-home listings.
Built Google Ads search campaigns with keyword themes and ad variants mapped to local search intent; tracked traffic and engagement in GA4.
Aligned messaging across Meta and Performance Max for consistent positioning, CTAs and lead-qualification prompts.
Built Instant Forms capturing location, budget and timeline, and segmented leads into nurture workflows that converted into booked viewings.
Managed the buyer pipeline: qualified inbound inquiries, handled objections, coordinated viewings and gave early-stage financing guidance.
Owned listing operations and the Virtual Tour workflow (capture, edit, publish), letting buyers view homes remotely.
Wrote Thai listing copy and short-form video scripts, using ChatGPT, Gemini and Midjourney to scale output while keeping the brand consistent.

items.desc: Produced low- and high-poly characters, props and environments; handled modeling, texturing, optimization and Unity integration with the team.
Edited photo and video and developed content concepts on-site with cross-functional production teams.
Contributed esports motion graphics with 9up Idea for Predator League Thailand.
Built the full brand system solo: mascot, LINE Rich Menu, content cards and a working storefront at khunmadam.com.
Python chatbot that explains Thai PEA/MEA tariffs, Ft and TOU rates in plain language and estimates the monthly bill.
